_: Fri 2 Oct 2026 · teaching slot. Note: calendar.json asserts Henry is due Nov 16. That could NOT be verified — the Tax Commissioner publishes no fixed date online, only 'the current due date'. So the card teaches the real trap instead: there is no single statewide date, and yours is on your bill. Do not restore the Nov 16 claim without a primary source.
headline:
The Only Tax Due Date
That Counts Is On Your Bill
turn_1: Echo, Georgia's default property tax due date is December 20. But a county can move it to December 1 or November 15, or split it into instalments.
turn_2: So there's no single date for everybody. How do I find mine?
turn_3: From the bill itself. Henry's office publishes no fixed date online — it says payment must reach them by the current due date, or carry a USPS postmark by it.
echo_line: So the envelope is the instruction, not the calendar. I'd read the date on mine before I assumed December.
source: Georgia Dept. of Revenue & Henry County Tax Commissioner · retrieved Sept 24, 2026
disclaimer: General information about county practice, not advice on any individual bill. Confirm your own date and balance with the Henry County Tax Commissioner.
